mentor.idea: Generation repeatedly predicts the next token from the current context, scales logits, optionally applies top-k, samples, and appends.

mentor.idea: The sampling script restores checkpoint weights, creates the GPT model and tokenizer, and decodes generated tokens.

mentor.idea: One training iteration fetches a batch, evaluates the model, backpropagates the loss, and updates weights.
mentor.reason: Inspect get_batch('train'), mixed-precision forward, loss.backward, optimizer.step, and checkpoint-saving conditions.
